title: Israr Ahmad v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Ashok Bhushan, J.; Sunita Agarwal, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; relegated to Supply Code for bill-correctness
headnote: Mandamus to issue a correct electricity bill matching an on-spot checking report refused. Correctness of the bill is to be raised under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; the writ is dismissed with liberty to pursue that remedy.
facts: Israr Ahmad filed a writ in the Allahabad High Court seeking a mandamus to the State and electricity authorities to issue a correct electricity bill as recorded in an on-spot checking report. He alleged the billed amount did not accord with that report. The Division Bench of Ashok Bhushan and Sunita Agarwal, JJ. disposed of the petition on 2 January 2012. The order does not set out the connection particulars, meter history, or the amount in dispute.

holding_units.holding: A consumer seeking a mandamus to issue a correct electricity bill matching an on-spot checking report must raise the correctness of the bill under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; the writ is dismissed with liberty to pursue that statutory remedy.
holding_units.flag: order cites U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 generally; no clause numbered

not_decided.point: Whether the electricity bill matched the on-spot checking report or required correction
not_decided.note: Left to the Supply Code remedy
